validation_qualification.53_59: no reference rendering or reference-name appearance found in any inventoried set; see checks below

53/59 absent. 57 present (legacy viewed pitch) but assigned the training role, which requires no blindness. 26 absent from this list.

checks.scope: acoustic_lab/backups/task39-1-20261010 (seal.json + tarballs), acoustic_lab/audio (exp_a_C1..C7, exp_b_c4_*, exp_c_c3_decay, test_c4)

Registered caveat: the later validation evaluation must render the devpiano side anew from the then-adopted table; these current-table renders must not be reused as the evaluation-side output, and their per-pitch recovery values must not be consulted when preparing the validation.

checks.scope: grep matches in phase38 PNG and legacy prefs files
checks.result: matched substrings are base64-like encoding content and a settings screenshot; no pitch-level data. Not viewing.

conclusion: Validation candidates 53/59 are reference-blind across every inventoried set. 25/27 remain condition-level holdouts as approved. Training pitches 26/52/57 require no blindness; 26's old consumed reference output is excluded from all fitting. The devpiano-side full-key render caveat is registered for the later validation evaluation.
not_a_guarantee: This audit covers the inventoried evidence trees and text-searched repositories only; it does not prove the absence of any viewing outside these locations.
